race.description: Petticoat For The Kosciuszko Cb Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: MISS TRUMP (10) nice filly who failed to make an impression in G2 class on debut in the Reisling last March. Sharp drop in grade first up with a fighting Maiden win over 1006m at Port Macquarie. Has the upside to go quickly through the grades and can keep the winning momentum going. CHEATING LILIBET (6) strengthened over the break and got the Maiden win out of the way second up. Covered ground from the sticky gate with a fading fifth over 1000m at Tuncurry on the soft (7) track. Will appreciate the firmer track today. Each way. DIZZY DEE (1) massive drop in class and kept fresh. Gets map favours and worth noting four of her wins have come at this track. Well placed to make amends. KATE'S TIARA (2) returned to form at her last two starts and the apprentice goes on for this. Gets a much better set up today, and can race closer in a weaker contest.
